title: Foundations of Levenshtein Distance & Edit Distance | Levenshtein.net

sections.heading: Foundations of Levenshtein Distance
sections.evidence: This section introduces the core concepts needed to understand Levenshtein distance and the wider family of edit-distance methods, including edit operations, string metrics, approximate string matching, and essential terminology.
paragraphs: This section introduces the core concepts needed to understand Levenshtein distance and the wider family of edit-distance methods, including edit operations, string metrics, approximate string matching, and essential terminology.

01 String Metrics: Distances, Similarities & Metric Properties Learn string metrics including Levenshtein, Hamming, Jaccard, cosine and Jaro-Winkler, with metric axioms, Unicode representation and indexing. Article · 16 min read

02 Levenshtein & Edit Distance Glossary: Terms and Definitions A technical glossary of Levenshtein distance, edit distance, string metrics, algorithms, dynamic programming, approximate matching, Unicode, alignment, and related terminology. Article · 26 min read

03 Edit Distance: Definition, Algorithms, Complexity & Applications Learn edit distance, Levenshtein distance, edit operations, dynamic programming, complexity, variants, Unicode representation and practical applications. Article · 12 min read

04 Edit Operations & Edit Scripts: Insertion, Deletion, Substitution Learn edit operations and edit scripts in Levenshtein distance: insertion, deletion, substitution, alignment, optimal paths, Unicode units and weighted costs. Article · 14 min read

05 Approximate String Matching: Algorithms, Models & Search Learn approximate string matching with Levenshtein distance, k differences, dynamic programming, automata, filtering, indexing, and Unicode-aware search. Article · 12 min read
